blocks.text: PROSPERIDAD, Agusan del Sur — Dengue infections across Agusan del Sur continued to spike, reaching 2,185 cases as of Monday, with 167 new infections and another fatality, bringing the deaths to 15, just four days after health officials declared an outbreak. The latest surveillance report from the Agusan del Sur Provincial Health Office (PHO) indicated that hospitalizations have strained local healthcare facilities, with 1,640 patients—representing 75 percent of all reported infections—requiring clinical admission.
